description: This Java source file defines the ApiGlobalErrorResponse class, which models standardized API error responses including error messages, status codes, and error details for the Fineract platform.

classes.name: ApiGlobalErrorResponse
classes.description: A class representing a standardized structure for API error responses, including error messages, status codes, and a list of specific parameter errors.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create an ApiGlobalErrorResponse with specified status code, message code, developer message, user message, and optional errors.

methods.name: unAuthenticated
methods.description: Creates an error response indicating the user is not authenticated.

methods.name: invalidTenantIdentifier
methods.description: Creates an error response for invalid tenant identification.

methods.name: invalidInstanceTypeMethod
methods.description: Creates an error response for invalid instance type method calls.

methods.name: loanIsLocked
methods.description: Creates an error response indicating a loan is locked.

methods.name: conflict
methods.description: Creates a conflict error response for concurrent modifications.

methods.name: unAuthorized
methods.description: Creates an error response for unauthorized access with specific user message.

methods.name: domainRuleViolation
methods.description: Creates an error response for domain rule violations.

methods.name: dataIntegrityError
methods.description: Creates an error response for data integrity issues.

methods.name: notFound
methods.description: Creates an error response indicating a resource was not found.

methods.name: badClientRequest
methods.description: Creates an error response for invalid client requests.

methods.name: jobIsDisabled
methods.description: Creates an error response indicating a job is disabled.

methods.name: serverSideError
methods.description: Creates an error response for server-side errors.

methods.name: serviceUnavailable
methods.description: Creates an error response indicating the service is unavailable.

methods.name: getErrors
methods.description: Getter for the list of ApiParameterError objects.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the error response object to a JSON string.
